_about: Each player's career clock read from the game's save (scripts/save_read.py --careers), written only by a save.careers upload mutation and replaced whole by each: born (age in season Y = Y - born), delay (retirement delays), signed (the season of the coach's last transaction with him: signed, re-signed or traded either way), club (his last club), left (retired or cut) and, for a retiree, last_games (his final season's games), ages (every age a save recorded, by season: the game sometimes holds a veteran's age, so born is the earliest season any save implies). scripts/infer_stints.py uses them as hard limits on each career. Never hand-edit.
